name: SVC_SELF_SERVICE_USERS
description: This table is used to store self-service users. The user data is denormalized data from svc_self_service_roles table. This table acts as a master table to the svc_self_service_roles child table, and the parent-child relationship is maintained through the AccountPartyId and ContactPartyId attributes. The denormalization is done in order to improve performance since the VO query based on the svc_self_service_roles table will not be performant with a large number of users.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: USER_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code for the type of user. Possible values are Contact and Consumer.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The party identifier of the account that is associated with the user.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The party identifier of the contact that is associated with the user.

columns.name: INITIAL_IDP_CD
columns.description: Name of the initial identity provider of the user.

columns.name: CURRENT_IDP_CD
columns.description: Name of the current identity provider of the user.

columns.name: ROLE_CODES
columns.description: A comma-separated list of role codes that are assigned to the user.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ADMIN_FLAG
columns.description: This column will store a flag value if the user has the account administrator role.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_MGR_FLAG
columns.description: This column will store a flag value if the user has the account manager role.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
